editorNote: Alphabet and Rocket Lab lead today's watchlist moves on a model launch and a record launch contract, while gold hovers near $4,150–$4,190 after softer inflation data and Citi lifts its bitcoin target. Everything above is reported fact or attributed analyst forecast, not advice.

stories.headline: Alphabet rises about 2% premarket after Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon
stories.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon on Wednesday, with an introductory price of $2 per million input and $10 per million output tokens and a one-million-token output limit. Alphabet Class A shares gained about 1.5% after hours and about 2% in Thursday premarket trading.
stories.whyItMatters: Shares had fallen 16% from their May 18 peak while investors awaited a flagship model; Jefferies cautioned that real-world use is needed to confirm the benchmark results.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab shares rise more than 5% premarket on a 20-launch Electron deal with Synspective
stories.summary: Rocket Lab will launch 20 StriX radar-imaging satellites for Japan's Synspective from Launch Complex 1 between 2028 and 2031, taking Synspective's total Electron bookings to 47 missions. The company's launch backlog now exceeds 100 missions.
stories.whyItMatters: It is the largest commercial Electron contract Rocket Lab has announced, and CEO Peter Beck called it a vote of confidence in Electron's cadence and reliability.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab's 20-Launch Synspective Deal Pushes Backlog Above 100 Missions (Benzinga)

stories.headline: Gold holds near $4,150–$4,190 as softer PCE inflation is offset by oil and Treasury yields
stories.summary: Spot gold was about $4,190 early Thursday and slipped toward $4,150 after giving back intraday gains. Core PCE rose 0.2% month over month, below the 0.3% expected, and PCE inflation was 2.6% in the 12 months through August.
stories.whyItMatters: Markets price about a 39% chance of an October rate hike, down from about 45% before the data, but elevated oil and yields kept gold from rallying.

sourceLinks.title: Gold price today, Thursday, October 1, 2026 (Yahoo Finance)
Gold rises after cooler inflation data, but monthly decline looms (CNBC)

stories.headline: Citi raises its 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 from $82,000 as bitcoin trades near $84,000
stories.summary: Citigroup also lifted its ether target to $3,028 from $2,240, citing stronger crypto activity, a supportive macro backdrop and a resumption of ETF inflows; it forecasts $5 billion of inflows over 12 months. Bitcoin and ether have risen nearly 40% and 68% over three months.
stories.whyItMatters: This is an analyst forecast, not an outcome; bitcoin's year-to-date loss has narrowed to about 4% and ether's to about 9%.
